final: WITH gender_counts AS (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) as order_count FROM Invoices i INNER JOIN Orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id INNER JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender), totals AS (SELECT SUM(order_count) as total FROM gender_counts), shares AS (SELECT gc.gender, gc.order_count, CAST(gc.order_count AS FLOAT) / CAST(t.total AS FLOAT) as share FROM gender_counts gc CROSS JOIN totals t), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_val FROM shares) SELECT s.gender, s.order_count, s.share, s.share - a.avg_val as share_minus_avg FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_val ORDER BY s.gender
